intro: 这一章只有两条定律（KCL、KVL）和几种元件的伏安关系（VCR），但后面每一章都建立在它们之上。最要紧的习惯是：**先在图上标出参考方向，再列方程**；算出负值只说明实际方向与参考方向相反。

en.intro: This chapter has only two laws (KCL, KVL) and the voltage–current relations (VCR) of a few elements, but every later chapter builds on them. The one habit that matters most: **mark the reference directions on the drawing first, then write the equations**; a negative result only means the actual direction is opposite to the reference.

ideas.title: 参考方向与关联参考方向
text: 电流、电压的方向事先不一定知道，所以先**任意假定**一个参考方向：电流画箭头，电压标“+”“−”（或双下标 u_ab = 从 a 到 b 的电压降）。计算结果为正，实际方向与参考方向相同；为负则相反。
对一个元件，如果电流从电压的“+”端流入、从“−”端流出，称 u、i 为**关联参考方向**；否则为**非关联参考方向**。关联与否只看同一个元件上 u 和 i 的箭头与极性怎样搭配，与实际方向无关。

en.title: Reference directions and the passive sign convention
text: The actual directions are usually not known in advance, so **choose** a reference direction first: an arrow for a current, “+” and “−” (or a double subscript: u_ab = voltage drop from a to b) for a voltage. A positive result means the actual direction agrees with the reference; a negative one means it is opposite.

For one element, if the current enters at the “+” terminal of its voltage and leaves at “−”, u and i follow the **passive sign convention**; otherwise they don't. Whether they are associated depends only on how the arrow and the polarity on the same element are drawn, not on the actual directions.

ideas.title: 电阻与欧姆定律（注意负号）
text: 线性电阻在关联参考方向下 u = Ri；在非关联参考方向下 u = −Ri。负号来自参考方向的选取，不是电阻变成了负的。
电阻吸收的功率 P = Ri² = u²/R，总是 ≥ 0：电阻只吸收功率。

en.title: Resistors and Ohm's law (mind the sign)
text: A linear resistor obeys u = Ri with the passive sign convention and u = −Ri without it. The minus sign comes from the choice of reference directions; the resistance does not become negative.
The power absorbed by a resistor, P = Ri² = u²/R, is always ≥ 0: a resistor only absorbs power.

ideas.title: 功率：吸收还是发出，功率守恒
text: 约定一律算**吸收**功率：关联参考方向下 P = ui，非关联参考方向下 P = −ui。P > 0 表示实际吸收，P < 0 表示实际发出。
电源不一定发出功率：电流从电压源“+”端流入时，电压源在吸收功率（例如被充电的电池）。受控源也可能吸收或发出功率。
**功率守恒**：一个电路中所有元件吸收的功率之和为零（发出的 = 吸收的）。这是检查答案最快的办法。

en.title: Power: absorbed or delivered; conservation of power
text: Always compute the **absorbed** power: P = ui with the passive sign convention, P = −ui without it. P > 0 means the element actually absorbs power, P < 0 that it delivers power.

A source does not necessarily deliver power: when current enters the “+” terminal of a voltage source, the source absorbs power (like a battery being charged). Dependent sources may also absorb or deliver.
**Conservation of power**: the absorbed powers of all elements in a circuit add up to zero (delivered = absorbed). It is the quickest check of an answer.

ideas.title: 独立电压源与独立电流源
text: **电压源**的端电压由它自己决定（U_s），与外电路无关；但**流过它的电流由外电路决定**，要用 KCL 或回路方程求。与电压源并联的元件，电压就是 U_s。
**电流源**的电流由它自己决定（I_s），与外电路无关；但**它两端的电压由外电路决定**，要用 KVL 求。与电流源串联的支路，电流就是 I_s。
所以：电压源的电流、电流源的电压，都不能“想当然”地取零或取某个值。

en.title: Independent voltage and current sources
text: A **voltage source** fixes its terminal voltage (U_s) whatever the rest of the circuit does, but **the current through it is set by the external circuit** — find it with KCL or a loop equation. Anything in parallel with a voltage source has voltage U_s.
A **current source** fixes its current (I_s), but **the voltage across it is set by the external circuit** — find it with KVL. A branch in series with a current source carries I_s.
So never assume the current of a voltage source, or the voltage of a current source, is zero or any fixed value.

ideas.title: 受控源：四种类型与识别
text: 受控源的电压或电流由电路中另一处的电压或电流（**控制量**）决定。按“谁控制谁”分为四种：电压控制电压源 VCVS（u = μu_1）、电压控制电流源 VCCS（i = gu_1）、电流控制电压源 CCVS（u = ri_1）、电流控制电流源 CCCS（i = βi_1）。符号是**菱形**。
识别方法：先看菱形里画的是电压源符号（+ −）还是电流源符号（箭头），决定后两个字母（VS / CS）；再看系数后面的控制量是电压还是电流，决定前两个字母（VC / CC）。
受控源反映的是电子器件（晶体管、放大器）的放大作用，**本身不是激励**：电路中没有独立源时，受控源不会产生任何电压、电流。它可以吸收也可以发出功率。

en.title: Dependent sources: four types and how to tell them apart
text: The voltage or current of a dependent source is set by a voltage or current elsewhere in the circuit (the **controlling quantity**). There are four kinds: voltage-controlled voltage source VCVS (u = μu_1), voltage-controlled current source VCCS (i = gu_1), current-controlled voltage source CCVS (u = ri_1), current-controlled current source CCCS (i = βi_1). The symbol is a **diamond**.

To identify one: the symbol inside the diamond (+ − for a voltage source, an arrow for a current source) gives the last two letters (VS / CS); the controlling quantity after the coefficient (a voltage or a current) gives the first two (VC / CC).

Dependent sources model the amplifying action of devices such as transistors and amplifiers; **they are not excitations**: with no independent source in the circuit they produce no voltage or current. They can absorb or deliver power.

ideas.title: 基尔霍夫电流定律 KCL：结点与闭合面
text: 任一时刻，流出任一结点的电流代数和为零：Σi = 0（也可以说“流入 = 流出”）。只要按参考方向统一规定“流出取正、流入取负”，符号就不会错。
KCL 对**任意闭合面（广义结点）**也成立：只看穿过闭合面的支路电流，闭合面内部有多复杂都不用管。
KCL 与元件性质无关（电阻、电源、受控源都适用），它表达的是电荷守恒。

en.title: Kirchhoff's current law (KCL): nodes and closed surfaces
text: At every instant the algebraic sum of the currents leaving any node is zero: Σi = 0 (equivalently, in = out). Fix one rule — leaving positive, entering negative, by the reference arrows — and the signs take care of themselves.
KCL also holds for **any closed surface (a generalised node)**: only the branch currents crossing the surface count, however complicated the inside is.
KCL does not depend on what the elements are (resistors, sources, dependent sources); it expresses conservation of charge.

ideas.title: 基尔霍夫电压定律 KVL：回路、开口回路与电位
text: 任一时刻，沿任一闭合回路绕行一周，各段电压降的代数和为零：Σu = 0。先选绕行方向，电压参考方向与绕行方向一致（从“+”走到“−”）的取正，相反的取负。
**开口回路**：两点间电压 u_ab 等于从 a 沿**任意一条路径**走到 b 的各段电压降之和，与路径无关。开路的两端没有电流，但可以有电压。
**电位**：选一个参考点（接地点，电位为零），某点电位 φ_a 就是该点到参考点的电压；u_ab = φ_a − φ_b。换参考点，各点电位都变，但两点间电压不变。

en.title: Kirchhoff's voltage law (KVL): loops, open paths and potentials
text: At every instant the algebraic sum of the voltage drops around any closed loop is zero: Σu = 0. Choose a direction of travel; a voltage whose reference agrees with it (going from “+” to “−”) counts positive, the others negative.
**Open paths**: the voltage u_ab is the sum of the drops along **any path** from a to b — the result does not depend on the path. Open terminals carry no current but can have a voltage.

**Potential**: choose a reference node (ground, potential zero); the potential φ_a of a point is its voltage to the reference, and u_ab = φ_a − φ_b. Changing the reference changes every potential but no voltage between two points.

ideas.title: 理想电表
text: 理想电流表内阻为零，在电路里相当于**短路**，读数是流过它的电流；理想电压表内阻无穷大，相当于**开路**，读数是它两端的电压。
解题时先把电流表换成导线、把电压表拿掉，解出电路后再按电表的接法和方向读数。

en.title: Ideal meters
text: An ideal ammeter has zero resistance — it is a **short circuit** — and reads the current through it; an ideal voltmeter has infinite resistance — an **open circuit** — and reads the voltage across it.
Replace ammeters by wires and remove voltmeters, solve the circuit, then read each meter according to how and in which direction it is connected.

ideas.title: 含受控源电路的解题步骤
text: 1. 把**控制量**当作一个未知数，在图上标出它的参考方向。
2. 先把受控源当作普通电源，用 KCL、KVL 和元件 VCR 列方程。
3. 补一个“控制量 = 用未知数表示”的方程，联立求解。
4. 求出控制量后，受控源就相当于一个已知数值的电源；最后用功率守恒验算。
不要把受控源“置零”或者当作独立源处理——它的值随电路状态变化。

en.title: Solving a circuit with dependent sources
text: 1. Treat the **controlling quantity** as an unknown and mark its reference direction on the drawing.
2. Treat the dependent source as an ordinary source and write KCL, KVL and the element VCRs.
3. Add one equation expressing the controlling quantity in terms of the unknowns, and solve the set.
4. Once the controlling quantity is known, the dependent source behaves like a source of known value; finally check with conservation of power.
Never set a dependent source to zero or treat it as an independent source — its value changes with the state of the circuit.

formulas.name: 吸收功率
formulas.when: u、i 为同一元件的电压、电流，关联参考方向（电流从“+”端流入）。P > 0 吸收，P < 0 发出。

en.name: Absorbed power
en.when: u and i of the same element, passive sign convention (current enters at “+”). P > 0 absorbs, P < 0 delivers.

formulas.name: 功率守恒
formulas.when: 对整个电路的所有元件（含独立源、受控源）求和，每个元件都按吸收功率计算。

en.name: Conservation of power
en.when: Sum over every element of the whole circuit (independent and dependent sources included), each counted as absorbed power.

formulas.name: 欧姆定律
formulas.when: 线性电阻；u、i 为关联参考方向时取正号。

en.name: Ohm's law
en.when: Linear resistor; plus sign with the passive sign convention.

formulas.name: 电阻的功率
formulas.when: 任何参考方向下都成立；电阻总是吸收功率。

en.name: Power of a resistor
en.when: Holds for any reference directions; a resistor always absorbs.

formulas.name: 独立源
formulas.expr: 电压源：u = U_s，i 由外电路定；电流源：i = I_s，u 由外电路定
formulas.when: 理想独立源；电压源不能短路，电流源不能开路。

en.name: Independent sources
en.expr: voltage source: u = U_s, i set by the circuit; current source: i = I_s, u set by the circuit
en.when: Ideal independent sources; never short a voltage source or open a current source.

formulas.name: 受控源
formulas.expr: VCVS u = μu_1；VCCS i = gu_1；CCVS u = ri_1；CCCS i = βi_1
formulas.when: u_1、i_1 为控制量（按图中标出的参考方向）；μ、β 无量纲，g 单位 S，r 单位 Ω。

en.name: Dependent sources
en.expr: VCVS u = μu_1; VCCS i = gu_1; CCVS u = ri_1; CCCS i = βi_1
en.when: u_1, i_1 are the controlling quantities (with the reference directions drawn); μ and β are dimensionless, g in S, r in Ω.

formulas.name: KCL
formulas.expr: Σ i_{流出} = 0　（Σ i_{流入} = Σ i_{流出}）
formulas.when: 任一结点或任一闭合面，任一时刻；按参考方向计正负，与元件性质无关。

en.name: KCL
en.when: Any node or closed surface, at every instant; signs by the reference arrows, whatever the elements are.

formulas.name: KVL
formulas.when: 沿任一闭合回路；与绕行方向一致的电压降取正。

en.name: KVL
en.when: Around any closed loop; voltage drops along the direction of travel count positive.

formulas.name: 两点间电压与电位
formulas.when: 沿从 a 到 b 的任意路径求和（开口回路也适用）；φ 以参考点为零。

en.name: Voltage between two points; potential
en.when: Sum the drops along any path from a to b (open paths too); φ is measured from the reference node.

formulas.name: 理想电表
formulas.expr: 电流表：R = 0（短路）；电压表：R = ∞（开路）
formulas.when: 读数的正负按电表标注的方向（电流从“+”端流入、电压为“+”端减“−”端）。

en.name: Ideal meters
en.when: The sign of a reading follows the meter's marked direction (current into “+”; voltage = “+” minus “−”).

examples.title: 两个电源，谁在发出功率？
examples.statement: 图示电路中 U_s = 10 V，R_1 = 2 Ω，R_2 = 4 Ω，电流源 I_s = 1 A（箭头向上，注入结点 a）。求结点 a 的电位 u_a、电流 i_1、i_2，各元件吸收的功率，并验证功率守恒。
steps: 1. **找未知数。** 只有结点 a 的电位未知（U_s 的“+”端电位就是 10 V）。用 u_a 表示各支路电流：i_1 = (10 − u_a)/2（欧姆定律，R_1 上 u、i 关联），i_2 = u_a/4。
3. **逐个判断关联与否，算吸收功率。**
- I_s：两端电压上“+”下“−”、为 8 V，电流从上端（“+”端）流出，非关联：P = −8 × 1 = **−8 W**（发出 8 W）。
4. **验算功率守恒：** −10 − 8 + 2 + 16 = 0 ✓。两个电源都在发出功率，全部被电阻吸收。

en.title: Two sources: which one delivers power?
en.statement: In the circuit U_s = 10 V, R_1 = 2 Ω, R_2 = 4 Ω and the current source I_s = 1 A (arrow up, into node a). Find the potential u_a of node a, the currents i_1 and i_2, the power absorbed by every element, and check conservation of power.
steps: 1. **Unknowns.** Only the potential of node a is unknown (the “+” terminal of U_s is at 10 V). Write the branch currents in terms of u_a: i_1 = (10 − u_a)/2 (Ohm's law, u and i of R_1 associated), i_2 = u_a/4.
2. **KCL at node a.** In = out: i_1 + I_s = i_2, i.e. (10 − u_a)/2 + 1 = u_a/4, so **u_a = 8 V**, hence **i_1 = 1 A** and **i_2 = 2 A**.
3. **Decide associated or not for each element; compute the absorbed power.**
- U_s: i_1 **leaves** its “+” terminal — not associated: P = −10 × 1 = **−10 W** (delivers 10 W).
- I_s: its voltage is 8 V, “+” at the top, and the current leaves at the top (“+”) — not associated: P = −8 × 1 = **−8 W** (delivers 8 W).
4. **Check conservation of power:** −10 − 8 + 2 + 16 = 0 ✓. Both sources deliver power, all of it absorbed by the resistors.

examples.title: 受控源发出功率、电压源反而吸收
examples.statement: 图示电路中 U_s = 12 V，R_1 = 4 Ω，R_2 = 6 Ω。电压控制电流源 G 的电流为 0.25u_2（单位 A，箭头向上，注入结点 a），u_2 为 R_2 两端的电压（“+”在上）。求 u_2、i_1、G 的电流，以及各元件吸收的功率。
steps: 1. **控制量当未知数。** 结点 a 的电位就是 u_2（R_2 接在 a 与地之间，“+”在上）。
4. **功率（吸收为正）。**
- G：两端电压上“+”、为 18 V，电流从上端流出，非关联：P = −18 × 4.5 = **−81 W**（发出）。
- U_s：实际电流 1.5 A 从“+”端流入，P = 12 × 1.5 = **18 W**——电压源在**吸收**功率。
5. **验算：** −81 + 18 + 9 + 54 = 0 ✓。受控源发出的功率来自它所代表的器件的外部电源，这里它把 u_a 抬到了比 U_s 还高。

en.title: A dependent source delivers, the voltage source absorbs
en.statement: In the circuit U_s = 12 V, R_1 = 4 Ω, R_2 = 6 Ω. The voltage-controlled current source G carries 0.25u_2 (in A, arrow up, into node a), where u_2 is the voltage across R_2 (“+” at the top). Find u_2, i_1, the current of G and the power absorbed by every element.
steps: 1. **Controlling quantity as an unknown.** The potential of node a is u_2 itself (R_2 is between a and ground, “+” at the top).
2. **KCL at node a, treating the dependent source as an ordinary current source:** i_1 + 0.25u_2 = u_2/6, with i_1 = (12 − u_2)/4.

3. **Solve:** (12 − u_2)/4 + 0.25u_2 = u_2/6 → 3 = u_2/6 → **u_2 = 18 V**. Hence **i_1 = −1.5 A** (negative: the actual current flows from a into U_s, against the arrow), and G carries 0.25 × 18 = **4.5 A**.
4. **Powers (absorbed positive).**
- G: 18 V across it, “+” at the top, current leaving at the top — not associated: P = −18 × 4.5 = **−81 W** (delivers).
- U_s: the actual 1.5 A enters its “+” terminal, P = 12 × 1.5 = **18 W** — the voltage source **absorbs** power.
5. **Check:** −81 + 18 + 9 + 54 = 0 ✓. The power delivered by a dependent source comes from the external supply of the device it models; here it lifts u_a above U_s.

mistakes.text: u、i 非关联时仍写 u = Ri（或 P = ui）。每写一个 VCR 或功率之前，先看这一个元件上箭头和“+”“−”怎样搭配。

en.text: Writing u = Ri (or P = ui) when u and i are not associated. Before each VCR or power, look at how the arrow and the “+ −” sit on that one element.

mistakes.text: 以为电源一定发出功率、电阻以外的元件一定不吸收功率。电压源的电流方向由外电路决定，电流从“+”端流入时它在吸收功率。

en.text: Assuming a source always delivers power. The current of a voltage source is set by the external circuit; when it enters the “+” terminal the source absorbs power.

mistakes.text: 把电流源两端的电压当成零，或者把电压源的电流当成零。电流源的电压、电压源的电流都要用 KVL / KCL 求出来。

en.text: Taking the voltage across a current source, or the current through a voltage source, as zero. Both must be found with KVL / KCL.

mistakes.text: 把受控源当成独立源（或在列方程时把它置零），漏了控制量方程。受控源的值是未知数的函数，要补一个控制量方程。

en.text: Treating a dependent source as an independent one (or zeroing it) and forgetting the controlling-quantity equation. Its value is a function of the unknowns.

mistakes.text: 开口回路求 u_ab 时方向弄反：u_ab 是从 a 走到 b 的电压降之和，走过一个电源时从“+”到“−”是降（取正），从“−”到“+”是升（取负）。

en.text: Getting the direction wrong for u_ab along an open path: u_ab is the sum of drops walking from a to b; through a source, “+” to “−” is a drop (positive), “−” to “+” a rise (negative).

mistakes.text: 混淆电位与电压：换参考点后各点电位都会变，但任意两点间的电压不变。

en.text: Mixing up potential and voltage: changing the reference changes every potential, but not the voltage between any two points.
